title: ranunculus alpestris subsp. bilobus
intro: Ranunculus alpestris subsp. bilobus, commonly known as the Alpine Buttercup or Snow Buttercup, is a plant species within the Ranunculaceae family, characterized by its unique, bilobed seed pods and delicate white or pale yellow flowers. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may aid in wound healing and reduce pain. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus alpestris subsp. bilobus include ranunculin, a glycoside with reported therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antimicrobial effects. However, further research is needed to confirm the plant's efficacy and potential side effects.
